newsitem.title: INDIA: Sandoz India to offer 10 shares in Ciba.
newsitem.headline: Sandoz India to offer 10 shares in Ciba.

text.p: Sandoz India said it will offer its shareholders 10 fully paid equity shares of 10 rupees each in Hindustan Ciba-Geigy Ltd in exchange for every 17 fully paid-up equity shares they hold in Sandoz India.
"The board of Sandoz India Ltd today approved the scheme of arrangement to merge the company into Hindustan Ciba-Geigy Ltd," the company said in a statement.

"Under the proposed merger, shareholders in Sandoz India will receive 10 fully paid equity shares of 10 rupees each (after sub-division of present par value of 100 rupees per share into 10 rupees each) in Hindustan Ciba-Geigy Ltd, to be renamed Novartis India Ltd, for every 17 fully paid shares of 10 rupees they hold in Sandoz India," it said in a statement.
The merged company will exclude the speciality chemicals businesses of Hindustan Ciba-Geigy Ltd, it said.
The new company will be a 51 percent subsidiary of Novartis AG, a Swiss-based transnational.

The global merger of Ciba-Geigy and Sandoz, to form Novartis, has been approved by shareholders of both Swiss firms and the European Commission and is awaiting U.S. Federal Trade Commission approval, Sandoz India said in a statement.
The Indian merger is further subject to approval by local shareholders and the high court of Bombay.
Sandoz India will convene an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders to seek approval for merger with Hindustan Ciba-Geigy Ltd.
"The merger in India would create a life sciences company with annual sales in excess of six billion rupees," it said.
